proof_body:
by
  intro α _ S T k hTS hTk
  rw [← Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hTS, ← Finset.card_powersetCard]
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun U => U \ T) (fun V => V ∪ T) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U hU
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hU
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    refine ⟨Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff hU.1.1 subset_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hU.2, hU.1.2]
  · intro V hV
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hV
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    have hd : Disjoint V T := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx hxT
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hV.1 hx)).2 hxT
    refine ⟨⟨Finset.union_subset (hV.1.trans Finset.sdiff_subset) hTS, ?_⟩, Finset.subset_union_right⟩
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd, hV.2]
    omega
  · intro U hU
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hU
    exact Finset.sdiff_union_of_subset hU.2
  · intro V hV
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hV
    have hd : Disjoint V T := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx hxT
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hV.1 hx)).2 hxT
    exact Finset.union_sdiff_cancel_right hd
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (S T : Finset α) (k : ℕ), T ⊆ S → T.card ≤ k → ((S.powersetCard k).filter (fun U => T ⊆ U)).card = (S.card - T.card).choose (k - T.card)
